verses.t: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an
verses.yusufAli: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital
verses.rodwell: SAY: It hath been revealed to me that a company of DJINN listened, and said, - "Verily, we have heard a marvellous discourse (Koran)
verses.sale: Say, it hath been revealed unto me that a company of genii attentively heard me reading the Koran, and said, verily we have heard an admirable discourse

verses.t: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone
verses.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord
verses.yusufAli: It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord
verses.rodwell: It guideth to the truth; wherefore we believed in it, and we will not henceforth join any being with our Lord
verses.sale: which directeth unto the right institution: Wherefore we believe therein, and we will by no means associate any other with our Lord

verses.t: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
verses.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son
verses.yusufAli: And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son
verses.rodwell: And He, - may the majesty of our Lord be exalted! - hath taken no spouse neither hath he any offspring
verses.sale: He -- may the majesty of our Lord be exalted! -- hath taken no wife, nor hath He begotten any issue

verses.t: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression
verses.pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie
verses.yusufAli: There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah
verses.rodwell: But the foolish among us hath spoken of God that which is unjust
verses.sale: Yet the foolish among us hath spoken that which is extremely false of God

verses.t: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie
verses.pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah
verses.yusufAli: But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah
verses.rodwell: And we verily thought that no one amongst men or Djinn would have uttered a lie against God
verses.sale: But we verily thought that neither man nor genius would by any means have uttered a lie concerning God

verses.t: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden
verses.pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah
verses.yusufAli: True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly
verses.rodwell: There are indeed people among men, who have sought for refuge unto people among Djinn: but they only increased their folly
verses.sale: And there are certain men who fly for refuge unto certain of the genii; but they increase their folly and transgression

verses.t: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]
verses.pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)
verses.yusufAli: And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment)
verses.rodwell: And they thought, as ye think, that God would not raise any from the dead
verses.sale: And they also thought, as ye thought, that God would not raise any one to life

verses.t: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames
verses.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors
verses.yusufAli: And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires
verses.rodwell: And the Heavens did we essay, but found them filled with a mighty garrison, and with flaming darts
verses.sale: And we formerly attempted to pry into what was transacting in heaven; but we found the same filled with a strong guard of angels, and with flaming darts

verses.t: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him
verses.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him
verses.yusufAli: We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush
verses.rodwell: And we sat on some of the seats to listen, but whoever listeneth findeth an ambush ready for him of flaming darts
verses.sale: And we sat on some of the seats thereof to hear the discourse of its inhabitants; but whoever listeneth now, findeth a flame laid in ambush for him, to guard the celestial confines

verses.t: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course
verses.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them
verses.yusufAli: And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct
verses.rodwell: And truly we know not whether evil be meant for them that are on earth, or whether their Lord meaneth guidance for them
verses.sale: And we know not whether evil be hereby intended against those who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth to direct them aright

verses.t: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways
verses.pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules
verses.yusufAli: There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths
verses.rodwell: And there are among us good, and others among us of another kind; - we are of various sorts
verses.sale: There are some among us who are upright; and there are some among us who are otherwise: We are of different ways

verses.t: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight
verses.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight
verses.yusufAli: But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight
verses.rodwell: And verily we thought that no one could weaken God on earth, neither could we escape from him by flight
verses.sale: And we verily thought that we could by no means frustrate God in the earth, neither could we escape Him by flight

verses.t: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden
verses.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression
verses.yusufAli: And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice
verses.rodwell: Wherefore as soon as we had heard 'the guidance' we believed in it; and whoever believeth in his Lord, need not fear either loss or wrong
verses.sale: Wherefore, when we had heard the direction contained in the Koran, we believed therein. And whoever believeth in his Lord, need not fear any diminution of his reward, nor any injustice

verses.t: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course
verses.pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully
verses.yusufAli: Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct
verses.rodwell: There are some among us who have resigned themselves to God (the Muslims); and there are others of us who have gone astray. And whoso resigneth himself to God pursueth the way of truth
verses.sale: There are some Moslems among us; and there are others of us who swerve from righteousness. And whoso embraceth Islam, they earnestly seek true direction

verses.t: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood
verses.pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell
verses.yusufAli: But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire
verses.rodwell: But they who go astray from it shall be fuel for Hell
verses.sale: But those who swerve from righteousness, shall be fuel for hell

verses.t: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
verses.pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
verses.yusufAli: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance
verses.rodwell: Moreover, if they (the Meccans) keep straight on in that way, we will surely give them to drink of abundant waters
verses.sale: If they tread in the way of truth, We will surely water them with abundant rain

verses.t: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment
verses.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment
verses.yusufAli: That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty
verses.rodwell: That we may prove them thereby: but whoso withdraweth from the remembrance of his Lord, him will He send into a severe torment
verses.sale: that We may prove them thereby: But whoso turneth aside from the admonition of his Lord, him will he send into a severe torment

verses.t: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone
verses.pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah
verses.yusufAli: And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah
verses.rodwell: It is unto God that the temples are set apart: call not then on any other therein with God
verses.sale: Verily the places of worship are set apart unto God: Wherefore invoke not any other therein together with God

verses.t: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass
verses.pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling
verses.yusufAli: Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd
verses.rodwell: When the servant of God stood up to call upon Him, the djinn almost jostled him by their crowds
verses.sale: When the servant of God stood up to invoke Him, it wanted little but that the genii had pressed on him in crouds, to hear him rehearse the Koran

verses.t: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner
verses.yusufAli: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)
verses.rodwell: SAY: I call only upon my Lord, and I join no other being with Him
verses.sale: Say, verily I call upon my Lord only, and I associate no other god with Him

verses.t: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you
verses.yusufAli: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct
verses.rodwell: SAY: No control have I over what may hurt or benefit you
verses.sale: Say, verily I am not able, of myself, to procure you either hurt, or a right institution

verses.t: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
verses.yusufAli: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him
verses.rodwell: SAY: Verily none can protect me against God; Neither shall I find any refuge beside Him
verses.sale: Say, verily none can protect me against God; neither shall I find any refuge besides Him

verses.t: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever
verses.pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever
verses.yusufAli: Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever
verses.rodwell: My sole work is preaching from God, and His message: and for such as shall rebel against God and his apostle is the fire of Hell! they shall remain therein alway, - for ever
verses.sale: I can do no more than publish what hath been revealed unto me from God, and his messages. And whosoever shall be disobedient unto God and his apostle, for him is the fire of hell prepared; they shall remain therein for ever

verses.t: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
verses.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude
verses.yusufAli: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers
verses.rodwell: Until they see their threatened vengeance they will be perverse! but then shall they know which side was the weakest in a protector and the fewest in number
verses.sale: Until they see the vengeance with which they are threatened, they will not cease their opposition: But then shall they know who were the weaker in a protector, and the fewer in number

verses.t: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it
verses.yusufAli: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term
verses.rodwell: SAY: I know not whether that with which ye are threatened be nigh, or whether my Lord hath assigned it to a distant day
verses.sale: Say, I know not whether the punishment with which ye are threatened be nigh, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term

verses.t: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
verses.pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret
verses.yusufAli: He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries
verses.rodwell: He knoweth the secret, nor doth He divulge his secret to any
verses.sale: He knoweth the secrets of futurity; and He doth not communicate his secrets unto any

verses.t: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
verses.pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
verses.yusufAli: Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him
verses.rodwell: Except to that Apostle who pleaseth Him; and before him and behind him He maketh a guard to march
verses.sale: except an apostle in whom He is well pleased: And He causeth a guard of angels to march before Him, and behind Him

verses.t: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number
verses.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things
verses.yusufAli: That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing
verses.rodwell: That He may know if his Apostles have verily delivered the messages of their Lord: and He embraceth in his knowledge all their ways, and taketh count of all that concerneth them
verses.sale: that He may know that they have executed the commissions of their Lord: He comprehendeth whatever is with them; and counteth all things by number
